Questions

What is OGTV?

OGTV is a free TV-style app for India: 40 always-on channels built from official YouTube uploads, from live news, cricket and the Olympics to Bollywood, bhajans, KBC, Taarak Mehta and documentaries, in Hindi and English. Open it and something is already playing.

Is OGTV free?

Yes. There is no sign-up and no subscription. Videos play from YouTube, so they work on any phone, laptop or smart TV with a browser.

Is OGTV a YouTube alternative?

It is a different way to watch YouTube. Instead of searching and scrolling, you flip through channels like on TV, and every channel runs to a schedule, so everyone tuned in sees the same moment.

How is OGTV different from OTT apps like Netflix, Hotstar or JioCinema?

OTT apps ask you to pick from a library and usually charge a subscription. OGTV is free live-style TV: channels that are always on, like cable TV, with no account and nothing to choose before watching.

Is there an OGTV app for phone or TV?

Yes. Open ogtv.thebharat.si and choose Install app (or Add to Home screen) in your browser. It then opens full screen like an app on Android, iPhone, laptops and smart TVs.

Which channels does OGTV have?

About

GTV

YouTube, the way TV used to be

OGTV turns Indian YouTube into 40 always-on channels, from cricket, Olympic sport and F1 to Bhakti, festivals, Doordarshan classics, Bollywood and science. No searching, no feeds: switch on, flip channels, watch what's on.

Everyone sees the same moment

Each channel runs on a schedule built from time-of-day rules, so every viewer tuned to a channel is at the same point of the same programme, like real TV. New uploads from 580+ creators, channels and playlists are added every night, and live channels pick up official streams as they go on air.
